Project Overview
Every successful business wants to expand its operations to other locations to drive growth. In order to penetrate into the new market, the company must set up its workstation in the right place. For this purpose, the parent company always considers the business premises that are specifically suitable for the type of industry in which they operate, the number of footfalls to be expected in the work area, a flexible working environment for the comfort of the employees, etc.
Therefore, the company representative traditionally travels to the location where he wants to set up a branch, inspects the property, discusses the space layout, the amenities, and understands the lease structure. This continues until the representative of the company finds the satisfactory property based on all parameters. The entire process requires a lot of time and effort.
Remote Property Measurement Application is a technology that property owners and agents can use through their smartphones (both Android and iOS). Through this solution, companies can eliminate the need of sending company representatives from one location to another for workplace inspection. Remote Property Measurement Application appraisers can collect extensive property data and take photos and video for the business to review the space. Remote Property Measurement Application is an integrated digital measuring tape that makes it easy for appraisers to determine square footage/GLA, and its 3-D scanning technology allows to deliver floor plans quickly and efficiently for lenders and appraisers alike. Therefore, using Remote Property Measurement Application, every organization can make a potential use of this technology for setting up the new workstation at another place with ease and convenience.
